subject: [hw] R1: T02 accepted (hw 6158/6158, check 22/22); one low modelling note
body:
I reviewed DONE T02 against its package entry and ran both suites:
  tests/hw/run_tests.sh    -> N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6158/6158 in ASan+UBSan, -O2 and TSan
  tests/check/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22 (JPEG/H.264/HEVC validators, positive and negative cases)
The fake n2vc_hw is well bounded: fgets/token/rule limits, a 32-step chain limit with -ELOOP, DMA first-fit with offset+bytes checks, one mutex around all state, no host pointer exposed to the guest beyond the explicit dma_host test accessor. The phone scripts are main-session-only, refuse to run without PHONE_EXEC, never flash/reset, and 50-recovery.md correctly forbids booting stock Android over the iOS userdata.

One low modelling note, not a defect for the current single-threaded host tests: fake_regs() and fake_wait_irq() hold the instance mutex while sleeping (DELAY/POLL/wait_irq). A second guest thread therefore cannot perform the register write that would trigger an IRQ while a first thread is in wait_irq; only the time-scheduled script IRQs can complete the wait. If V40/V41 later exercise cross-thread IRQ delivery, consider a condition variable signalled by the write path and by a timer instead of sleeping under the lock. T02 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
